high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post from a user named Sofianos Drapaniotis. The post provides information about the Tunnel of Eupalinos, an ancient aqueduct located on the island of Samos, Greece. The text details that the tunnel is 1036 meters long and was built in the 6th century BC to serve as an aqueduct. It mentions that the Eupalinian aqueduct was used for a thousand years, as evidenced by archaeological findings, and was rediscovered between 1882 and 1884.
